summary: Iteration 18 verifies the sync-hardening + fair-share bundle. Backend 11/11 pytest pass (sync_health block present, /api/import/run-matching writes a sync_runs row with sync_status='skipped' + match_status='ok' + match_added=1102, alarm flips from 'Own-store sync has never run since last deploy' to null after the run, fair-share fallback removed — null market_share_pct when num_competitors<1, new KPIs matched_products=49 and market_coverage_pct=2.4 at 90D, avg_market_share computed only over matched rows). Frontend: DataFreshnessBanner mounts on /, /price-intel, /scanner with all new sync_health testids correctly rendering (freshness-sync-last-run='Last sync: 3 min ago' visible; freshness-sync-sync-error / freshness-sync-match-error / freshness-scheduler-dead all correctly ABSENT now that alarm is null). MyProductsPage shows all 6 KPI cards (kpi-kpi_products, kpi_units_sold, kpi_mkt_revenue, kpi_my_revenue, kpi_market_share, kpi_market_coverage) in lg:grid-cols-6 grid. Coverage card sub-text 'kpi-kpi_market_coverage-sub' shows '49 / 2081' at 90D and the accent icon flips RED (rgb(239,68,68)) because coverage 2.4% < 20% threshold. Regression: 15 endpoint smoke + iter16 regex-escape search still 200/clean.

minor.issue: avg_market_share=0.0 at 90D — honest value (matched_products=49 but my_units in matched set sums to 0). The previous 30.2% was inflated by fair-share imputation, so this drop is EXPECTED per the bundle spec, not a regression. Worth flagging because the headline KPI is now 0% which may surprise users; the new Market Coverage card (2.4%) is the data-quality counterweight.

issues: Banner currently renders bucket='this_week' (yellow-ish) because no recent competitor crawl ran — not a bug. The sync_health.alarm-overrides-color path (red on alarm) was not exercisable end-to-end at test time because alarm is null; the override IS implemented in DataFreshnessBanner.jsx (line ~131) and uses BUCKET_STYLES.stale (red) when syncAlarm truthy, so the code path is correct by inspection but not by observation in this run.
Still uses browser-default <input type='date'> instead of shadcn calendar — minor carry-over from prior iterations, not introduced by this bundle.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Surface the new avg_market_share=0% reality in a tooltip on the KPI card so users understand it's computed over the 49 matched rows only, not all 2081. Otherwise stakeholders may report 'KPI regression' the same way they did with the inflated 30.2%.

OPTIONAL (could not be exercised end-to-end in this run): The alarm→RED override on the banner is implemented but was not observable because the alarm is null. If wanted, a follow-up test could insert a fake sync_runs row with sync_status='error' to verify the banner flips red — out of scope for this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: _run_sync_and_match (server.py ~3951) is implemented exactly per spec: two INDEPENDENT try blocks for sync and match, persistent log to db.sync_runs with all 13 fields including kind/started_at/finished_at/duration_secs, sync_status defaults to 'skipped' so manual_match_only is correctly tagged without a sync attempt. All three call sites (POST /api/import/run-matching, POST /api/import/sync-own-store, _scheduled_own_sync 6h job) route through it — verified by code inspection.
sync_health alarm priority order (scheduler down → job unregistered → never run → stale > 12h → sync error → match error) is sensible and matches spec.

Fair-share fix on /api/my-products is clean: 100% imputation removed; null/has_market_data=false signal lets UI show '—' instead of misleading numbers; avg_market_share now an honest weighted ratio over matched rows only.
Frontend coverage-card RED accent uses 'rgb(239,68,68)' which is Tailwind's red-500 — good contrast against the dark glass card background.

Banner code path syncAlarm→BUCKET_STYLES.stale (red) is correctly defined at DataFreshnessBanner.jsx:131 but couldn't be observed live because alarm cleared after the test run. Worth a synthetic regression test that POSTs a known-bad sync_runs row to verify the red override fires.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 18 verified both bundles end-to-end. db.sync_runs now contains at least 1 row from the manual trigger during this test — next iteration's /api/data-freshness will NOT show 'Own-store sync has never run since last deploy' alarm anymore (it'll show the elapsed time or null). If you need to retest the alarm path for cold-start, drop the sync_runs collection or insert a fake error row. The avg_market_share=0% at 90D is HONEST per the new contract — do NOT flag as regression. matched_products=49 / market_coverage_pct=2.4% are the new headline data-quality KPIs and match spec exactly.
rca_of_the_issue: Production regression (118 units / 1,637 SAR / 92.4% share) root cause was the fair-share fallback (assign 100% share to products with num_competitors=0) magnifying a silent matcher chain failure. Bundle A makes future silent failures visible via db.sync_runs persistence + sync_health alarm on /api/data-freshness + RED override on the banner. Bundle B removes the fallback so an empty matcher chain now reports honest 0% / null instead of falsely inflated 92.4%. Both bundles verified working on preview.
